AN ACT to appropriate certain sums of money for the
use of the Public Service of Belize for the financial
year ending March 31, 2016.
(Gazetted 1st April, 2015)
BE IT ENACTED, by and with the advice and consent of
the House of Representatives and the Senate of Belize
and by the authority of the same, as follows:-
1. This Act may be cited as the Short title.
GENERAL REVENUE APPROPRIATION
(2015/2016) ACT, 2015.

12 General Revenue Appropriation (2015/2016) [No. 2
Appropriation 2. The several sums of money appearing in the Schedule
of sums of hereto are hereby declared to be payable for the financial
money in the
Schedule. year ending on the thirty first day of March, two thousand
and sixteen, in respect of the services mentioned in the
Schedule and shall be charged on the revenue for the year
and other funds of Belize.
Expenditure 3. Any sum not exceeding the amount set down under
authorized. each Head in the Schedule hereto may be issued and spent
in respect of the establishment of service specified or referred
to therein.
